explication: Lynis is a UNIX security auditing and hardening tool. The documented workflow is an administrator launching `./lynis audit system`, which runs a local system scan and provides findings and hardening tips. The tree identifies the command entry point, test families, knowledge databases, profiles, and reporting modules; without source excerpts, internal call relationships and the exact scan-to-report wiring cannot be verified.
